_meta.description: Submit a prompt to Grok and capture the response.

prompt.description: The prompt/question to send to Grok
prompt.hint: Can be any length. For multi-line, use newlines in the string.

base_url.description: URL to navigate to before submitting. Default = fresh single-turn chat.
base_url.hint: Can point to an existing grok.com/c/<id> conversation to continue a thread

_meta.notes: Grok uses Tiptap/ProseMirror contenteditable (not textarea). Healed 2026-07-10 WQ-164 against live DOM: (1) added navigate step (recipe had none, ran against wrong tab); (2) Grok does NOT submit on Enter — type(submit:false) then click button[data-testid='chat-submit'] (aria-label 'Submit'); (3) completion signal = the button[aria-label='Regenerate'] action toolbar that appears only on a FINISHED message (Grok is fast; the transient stop button is hard to catch, Regenerate is stable); (4) read = .response-content-markdown, which is the answer only — Grok's 'Thought for Ns' preamble lives in a separate node.

params.prompt: Say hello in exactly one sentence.

send_button.description: Submit button — button[data-testid='chat-submit'] (aria-label 'Submit'); appears once the input has text

chain.note: Navigate the (authenticated) tab to base_url. Added 2026-07-10 WQ-164 — recipe had no navigate step so it ran against whatever tab was active. Default base_url=grok.com/ = fresh single-turn chat, keeping the s7 read reliable.
Type only. Grok ignores Enter-submit (verified 2026-07-10 WQ-164) — the Send button click follows.
Submit button appears once the input has text
Response body appeared (streaming started). onTimeout:continue covers a near-instant answer.
Completion signal (2026-07-10 WQ-164, replaces the 30s fixed delay): the Regenerate action button appears under the message only once generation is complete.
settle on the rendered answer before read

Read the answer. .response-content-markdown is the answer body only — excludes Grok's 'Thought for Ns' preamble (verified live 2026-07-10 WQ-164). Replaces the broken '[class*=markdown]:last-of-type'.
